## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: Describe events and actions as they occur over time  
2. **Visual Details**: Describe all visual details you want to appear in the video  
3. **Audio**: Describe sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

nodes.title: dialogue-ltx23: how to use
widgets_values:
# dialogue-ltx23
LTX-2.3 FLF audio-driven, stage A only. Close-up and medium dialogue.
**Inputs:** start image, end image, voice (`in_audio`, the voice wav, e.g. from ElevenLabs), prompt.
Set **in_speech_seconds** to the voice length (a little over is fine, it only adds tail).

**Padding:** `in_lead_in_seconds` (default 1.0) of silence before the first word, so the face
settles before speech starts; `in_tail_seconds` (default 0.75) after the last word, as a cut handle.
num_frames is computed: (speech + lead-in + tail) x fps, rounded up to 8n+1.
Max clip for this model: 10 s, so speech up to 10 - 1.75 s at default padding.

Seed: `in_seed` (fixed).
